_zonesComment: What each Zone IS, never what colour it should be (ADR-0020: design owns treatment, the venue owns relationships). Hand-authored curation, not harvest output — the re-harvest onto the classes schema (#26) dropped it, and with it the Visual factory's `lean` term, so every Zone recompiled to bare ground while the packs on disk still carried the leaned tones. Restored so a recompile reproduces them (#31). Rivertown and Camp Snoopy are the wooded ones, Soak City and Adventure Port the water ones, Action Zone and Area 72 the steel quarter, Coney Mall and Planet Snoopy midway, International Street the civic boulevard you enter through. Oktoberfest stays deliberately unlisted: it has always taken whatever a Zone nobody characterised looks like.
